name: BRISC and BRCA1 A complex member 2

function.text: BABAM2 encodes BRISC and BRCA1-A complex member 2. Annotated molecular activities include peroxisome signal sequence receptor activity and polyubiquitin modification-dependent protein binding. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA repair.

function.text: BABAM2 encodes BRISC and BRCA1-A complex member 2. It forms part of the BRCA1-A complex, a complex that specifically recognizes 'Lys-63'-linked ubiquitinated histones H2A and H2AX at DNA lesions sites, leading to target the BRCA1-BARD1 heterodimer to sites of DNA damage at double-strand breaks (DSBs). The BRCA1-A complex also possesses deubiquitinase activity that specifically removes 'Lys-63'-linked ubiquitin on histones H2A and H2AX. It forms part of the BRISC complex, a multiprotein complex that specifically cleaves 'Lys-63'-linked ubiquitin in various substrates.
